additional_info.subject: Urgent Request for Analysis – Incident on SiD Chargers – P&G Amiens
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am reaching out following an incident reported by our client, P&G Amiens, regarding two Siemens SiD charging stations:
• S/N: Y2/R4 31298223001
• S/N: Y2/R5 313048135001
Mr. Juan Borrero, from P&G Amiens, the client’s representative, informed us that the superchargers are not functioning. Several tests were carried out with all four units, using various Thor devices (eTrucks), but no connection could be established.
Here is his message:
“I am contacting you regarding an incident with the Siemens superchargers, which are not working. We have carried out tests with all four units and several Thor devices, but we are unable to connect to them. Could you please look into this and provide a solution during the day? It’s quite urgent. Thank you in advance for your help.”
We would appreciate it if you could analyze the issue and get back to us as soon as possible, given the urgent nature of the client’s request.
Please let me know if you need any further information.
Best regards,
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
